import json, sys

def solve(request):
    memory = list(request["memory"])
    threads = request["threads"]
    nthreads = len(threads)
    instrs = [list(t) for t in threads]
    n = [len(instrs[t]) for t in range(nthreads)]
    mem0 = tuple(memory)

    # state: (pcs tuple, buffers tuple-of-tuples, mem tuple, obs tuple-of-tuples)
    init_pcs = tuple([0]*nthreads)
    init_bufs = tuple(() for _ in range(nthreads))
    init_obs = tuple(() for _ in range(nthreads))
    init = (init_pcs, init_bufs, mem0, init_obs)

    def byte_of_store(store, addr):
        a, w, v = store
        return (v >> (8*(addr-a))) & 0xff

    def do_load(buf, mem, addr, w):
        out = 0
        for i in range(w):
            ba = addr + i
            val = None
            for s in reversed(buf):
                sa, sw, sv = s
                if sa <= ba < sa+sw:
                    val = (sv >> (8*(ba-sa))) & 0xff
                    break
            if val is None:
                val = mem[ba]
            out |= val << (8*i)
        return out

    results = set()
    visited = set()
    stack = [init]
    while stack:
        st = stack.pop()
        if st in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(st)
        pcs, bufs, mem, obs = st
        any_trans = False
        # instruction transitions
        for t in range(nthreads):
            if pcs[t] < n[t]:
                instr = instrs[t][pcs[t]]
                op = instr[0]
                if op == "store":
                    _, a, w, v = instr
                    nb = bufs[t] + ((a, w, v),)
                    npc = list(pcs); npc[t] += 1
                    nb2 = list(bufs); nb2[t] = nb
                    stack.append((tuple(npc), tuple(nb2), mem, obs))
                    any_trans = True
                elif op == "load":
                    _, a, w = instr
                    val = do_load(bufs[t], mem, a, w)
                    no = list(obs); no[t] = no[t] + (val,)
                    npc = list(pcs); npc[t] += 1
                    stack.append((tuple(npc), bufs, mem, tuple(no)))
                    any_trans = True
                elif op == "fence":
                    if not bufs[t]:
                        npc = list(pcs); npc[t] += 1
                        stack.append((tuple(npc), bufs, mem, obs))
                        any_trans = True
                elif op == "xchg":
                    if not bufs[t]:
                        _, a, w, v = instr
                        # read shared memory
                        val = 0
                        for i in range(w):
                            val |= mem[a+i] << (8*i)
                        nm = list(mem)
                        for i in range(w):
                            nm[a+i] = (v >> (8*i)) & 0xff
                        no = list(obs); no[t] = no[t] + (val,)
                        npc = list(pcs); npc[t] += 1
                        stack.append((tuple(npc), bufs, tuple(nm), tuple(no)))
                        any_trans = True
        # drain transitions
        for t in range(nthreads):
            if bufs[t]:
                s = bufs[t][0]
                a, w, v = s
                nm = list(mem)
                for i in range(w):
                    nm[a+i] = (v >> (8*i)) & 0xff
                nb2 = list(bufs); nb2[t] = bufs[t][1:]
                stack.append((pcs, tuple(nb2), tuple(nm), obs))
                any_trans = True
        if not any_trans:
            # terminal
            results.add((obs, mem))

    outcomes = []
    for obs, mem in results:
        outcomes.append({"reads": [list(o) for o in obs], "memory": list(mem)})
    return {"outcomes": outcomes}

if __name__ == '__main__':

import sys

def solve_core(request):
    memory=list(request["memory"]); threads=request["threads"]
    nthreads=len(threads); instrs=[list(t) for t in threads]
    n=[len(instrs[t]) for t in range(nthreads)]; mem0=tuple(memory)
    init=(tuple([0]*nthreads),tuple(() for _ in range(nthreads)),mem0)
    memo={}
    stats={'core':0,'maxset':0,'sumset':0}
    EMPTY=tuple(() for _ in range(nthreads))
    def compute(C):
        if C in memo: return memo[C]
        stats['core']+=1
        pcs,bufs,mem=C
        res=set()
        any_trans=False
        for t in range(nthreads):
            if pcs[t]<n[t]:
                instr=instrs[t][pcs[t]]; op=instr[0]
                if op=="store":
                    _,a,w,v=instr
                    nb=list(bufs); nb[t]=nb[t]+((a,w,v),)
                    npc=list(pcs); npc[t]+=1
                    C2=(tuple(npc),tuple(nb),mem)
                    for o,m in compute(C2): res.add((o,m))
                    any_trans=True
                elif op=="load":
                    _,a,w=instr; out=0
                    for ii in range(w):
                        ba=a+ii; val=None
                        for s in reversed(bufs[t]):
                            sa,sw,sv=s
                            if sa<=ba<sa+sw: val=(sv>>(8*(ba-sa)))&0xff; break
                        if val is None: val=mem[ba]
                        out|=val<<(8*ii)
                    npc=list(pcs); npc[t]+=1
                    C2=(tuple(npc),bufs,mem)
                    for o,m in compute(C2):
                        no=list(o); no[t]=(out,)+no[t]
                        res.add((tuple(no),m))
                    any_trans=True
                elif op=="fence":
                    if not bufs[t]:
                        npc=list(pcs); npc[t]+=1
                        C2=(tuple(npc),bufs,mem)
                        for o,m in compute(C2): res.add((o,m))
                        any_trans=True
                elif op=="xchg":
                    if not bufs[t]:
                        _,a,w,v=instr; val=0
                        for ii in range(w): val|=mem[a+ii]<<(8*ii)
                        nm=list(mem)
                        for ii in range(w): nm[a+ii]=(v>>(8*ii))&0xff
                        npc=list(pcs); npc[t]+=1
                        C2=(tuple(npc),bufs,tuple(nm))
                        for o,m in compute(C2):
                            no=list(o); no[t]=(val,)+no[t]
                            res.add((tuple(no),m))
                        any_trans=True
        for t in range(nthreads):
            if bufs[t]:
                a,w,v=bufs[t][0]; nm=list(mem)
                for ii in range(w): nm[a+ii]=(v>>(8*ii))&0xff
                nb=list(bufs); nb[t]=bufs[t][1:]
